title: The Agreement Layer for the Modern Agentic Enterprise
summary: We’re excited to announce that we’re opening our Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server to every AI agent. On September 30, the Docusign MCP server will be generally available.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce that we’re opening our Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server to every AI agent. On September 30, the Docusign MCP server will be generally available. Agreement intelligence and governed action, powered by our AI engine, Docusign Iris, will be callable from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Slack, and any MCP client, through a single standard interface.


The[Docusign MCP Server](https://www.docusign.com/products/mcp) enables teams to use Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) platform from inside the familiar chat tools and third-party agentic systems that they’re already using – and use IAM to gain access to external agentic systems without leaving IAM.


Here’s some context from Docusign CEO, Allan Thygesen:


"For enterprise AI to truly succeed, it must integrate with the foundational systems businesses rely on. As the starting point for agreement tasks shifts toward AI agents, these agents require a robust framework to analyze terms and execute end-to-end workflows. By opening our MCP Server, Docusign will become the essential agreement layer for any platform's agent, leveraging deep context and the rigorous governance customers demand. This is what evolves a connected agent into a trusted partner for contract management."


This builds on the 20-year legacy of our open API platform, delivering freedom of choice without sacrificing the underlying agreement infrastructure. And it doesn't stop at pre-built integrations: enterprise customers and developers can now build agreement intelligence and workflows directly into their own custom agents.


## Security, precision, and automation you can trust


Autonomous contract management is only valuable if it's governed. The Docusign MCP Server is backed by enterprise-grade security, account-level admin controls, global multi-region infrastructure, and multilingual support across both IAM and CLM. Powered by Iris, our agreement-tuned AI, agents act with full context rather than guessing — drawing on past negotiations, accepted terms, and company policy.


## Move agreements forward without switching apps


Agreements no longer wait in an app someone has to open. By embedding native contract analysis, sending, and tracking directly where work already happens, Docusign can eliminate the app-switching that slows deals down.


This works bidirectionally: systems like Oracle can be pulled directly into Docusign, while Docusign's own capabilities extend outward into Slack, Perplexity, and Salesforce — where Iris runs natively alongside Agentforce. It's this kind of deep, native integration that helped Docusign to be recognized as a Salesforce Partner of the Year Award Winner.


"Salesforce delivers AI agents you can trust, serving customers 24/7, generating new pipeline, and handling routine work at scale — so people can focus on judgment, relationships, and growth. Collaborating with Docusign adds real value for customers who are building their Agentic Enterprise with Salesforce. Agentforce and Slackbot will read and act on contract terms in real-time to accelerate high value sales and service actions. Together we accelerate business processes that our customers really care about," said Joe Inzerillo, President Enterprise & AI Technology, Salesforce.


With the Docusign MCP Server, the AI tools your teams already use can analyze, act on, and move agreements forward, without compromising the trust, security, and precision that agreement work demands.
